integrity: All-dimensional coordinate/Dyck-area proof independently reconstructed. For n=2..5 an independent exact vertex enumeration checked the norms, shell numbers and outer contact counts. Finite enumeration is corroborative, not a proof for arbitrary n.
scientific_limitations: Ardila's specific integral realization and inherited Euclidean metric only. All distinct vertex radial levels, unique circumball, and farthest-shell multiplicity are determined; intermediate shell multiplicities, other deformations, other metrics and global exhaustive priority certification are not claimed.
title: Exact Euclidean radial spectrum of the bipermutahedron
